title: Identité juridique : progrès en matière d'enregistrement des naissances et digitalisation
publisher: Ministère de l'Administration territoriale et de la Décentralisation, Direction nationale de l'état civil
why_not: An ID4Africa 2025 presentation, outside the twelve-month window; its digital facts are archive class (over 5,000,000 acts scanned and indexed, over 109 centres given archiving kits) and it states no digital entry of new events at any centre. It does give the office count: 747 principal and 292 secondary centres, over 8,000 declaration centres.
